messages:
Maya P: Quick sync — need input on the pre-launch risk & experiment plan for the new version pinning behavior. TL;DR: customers want per-tenant pin windows + auto-fallback; product asks for canary + A/B to validate regressions. Need acceptance criteria, rollout gates, and rollback rules.
Devon: +1. Can we make the rollout gates explicit? e.g., latency P95 delta < 10ms, cost uplift < 8%, no more than 0.5% error-rate increase over 24h.
Samir: Suggest design: staged canary -> 1% tenants for 6h, 5% for 24h, 25% for 48h, then ramp. For A/B: 50/50 on compatible traffic to surface quality drift via eval hooks.
Alex: Important: pin windows should be tenant-scoped with explicit TTL and an override flag. If model variant fails, route to fallback variant and record event. Rollback kill-switch must be infra-enforced.
Rita: A couple of enterprise customers asked for longer pins (7d). We should include opt-in policy per contract. Also need audit logs for compliance.
Devon: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) No regressions on golden prompt set (automated eval pass rate >= 99%), 2) No unhandled exceptions in serving layer, 3) Rollback can be executed < 10min via console or API, 4) Observability: per-tenant trace and cost delta visible in console within 5min.
Samir: Edge case: tenants with intermittent short burst quotas — they could inflate metrics. Add rule to exclude tenants with <1000 tokens/day from experiment metrics.
Alex: Ops notes: implement traffic split config like:
```json
{
  "strategy": "tenant_pin",
  "buckets": [{"name":"canary","pct":1}, {"name":"staged","pct":5}],
  "fallback": "v1-stable"
}
```
Make sure this config is readable by the routing layer and safe to update via feature flag.
Rita: Timeline ask: product wants canary by next Tue. Engineering capacity?
Maya P: Targeting Tue is aggressive but doable if we freeze scope: only tenant pin + fallback + monitoring. Defer long-pin contract work to follow-up.
Devon: Experiment analysis: define primary metric = relative EM distance on eval set, secondary = latency P95 and cost/token. Add alert thresholds and automatic rollback policy: if primary_metric drops > 2% and sustained for 30m -> auto-fallback.
Samir: Questions for security: how are keys handled for private deployments? @security? (cc @Rita for customer notes)
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: canary-config-v2 -> staging at 2024-11-08T14:00Z.
Maya P: OK — next steps: 1) eng to post a short PRD snippet with acceptance criteria, 2) eng -> ops to add kill-switch runbook, 3) data -> set up eval hooks and exclusion rules. I'll collect signoffs by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Devon: I'll draft the PRD snippet.
Alex: I'll own kill-switch runbook and console API.
Rita: I'll coordinate with affected customers for opt-in.
Samir: I'll set up the experiment dashboards and exclusion filters.
Maya P: Thanks all — posting this thread to the PRD as the rollout appendix. :eyes:
